name: shotloom
description: Desktop workspace for AI filmmaking: infinite canvas, agent tools, 3D previsualization and video editing.

scripts.predev: npm run config:generate && npm run prepare:director-desk && npm run prepare:openreel && npm run prepare:media && npm run prepare:screenshots
scripts.predev:web: npm run config:generate && npm run prepare:director-desk && npm run prepare:openreel && npm run prepare:screenshots && npm run prepare:harness
scripts.prebuild:desktop: npm run prepare:director-desk && npm run prepare:openreel && npm run prepare:media
scripts.build: npm run config:generate && npm run prepare:director-desk && npm run prepare:harness && npm run prepare:openreel && npm run prepare:screenshots && vite build
scripts.check: npm run config:check && npm run typecheck && npm run check:i18n && npm run check:storage && npm run check:layers && npm run check:styles && npm run check:ui && npm run check:tests && npm test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm --prefix vendor/shotloom-director-desk run typecheck
scripts.harness:test: npm run harness:build && npm --prefix harness/host test
scripts.verify:product: npm run prepare:openreel && npm run prepare:screenshots && npm run check && npm run harness:test && npm run build && npm run harness:verify-package
